c2-jdg-0004: The LORD tells of a change in what He will do. Read Judges 2:21.
c2-jdg-0005: Israel cried out, and the LORD raised up a helper. Ammon camped in Gilead. Read Judges 3:9 and Judges 10:17.
c3-jdg-0001: The LORD raised up a deliverer when Israel cried out. The elders of Gilead spoke. Read Judges 3:15 and Judges 11:10.
c3-jdg-0002: Ehud made a dagger. Later Jephthah speaks of a struggle. Read Judges 3:16 and Judges 12:2.
c3-jdg-0003: After that generation was gathered to their fathers, another arose. The leaders of Gilead sought a fighter. Read Judges 2:10 and Judges 10:18.
c3-jdg-0004: Jephthah sent messengers to the people of Ammon. Ehud came and spoke. Read Judges 3:20 and Judges 11:12.
c3-jdg-0005: The men of Ephraim gathered and crossed toward Zaphon. A request was made of Jephthah. Read Judges 11:6 and Judges 12:1.
c3-jdg-0006: The men of Gilead defeated Ephraim. The LORD’s anger was hot against Israel. Read Judges 3:8 and Judges 12:4.
c3-jdg-0007: Joshua dismissed the people, and each went to his inheritance. The elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah. Read Judges 11:5 and Judges 2:6.
c3-jdg-0008: The LORD reminds Israel of earlier deliverance. After the battle, the verse continues. Read Judges 3:13 and Judges 10:12.
c2-deu-0017: The words of this law were to be written on the stones. Read Deuteronomy 27:8.
c2-deu-0018: A blessing is named for the day’s travel. Some shall stand on Mount Ebal. Read Deuteronomy 28:6 and Deuteronomy 27:13.
c3-deu-0005: Moses names a curse on anyone who will not confirm the words of this law. Read Deuteronomy 28:7 and Deuteronomy 27:26.
c3-deu-0006: All of them stand today before the LORD their God. Read Deuteronomy 28:12 and Deuteronomy 29:10.
c3-deu-0007: A charge is given to keep the commandments. A blessing is named for the storehouses. Read Deuteronomy 28:8 and Deuteronomy 27:1.
c3-deu-0008: Some shall stand on Mount Ebal to curse. Read Deuteronomy 28:23 and Deuteronomy 27:13.
c3-deu-0009: The whole people stand together before the LORD. Hear His promise. Read Deuteronomy 28:13 and Deuteronomy 29:10.
c3-deu-0010: They have become the people of the LORD their God. The later verse continues after He gathers them. Read Deuteronomy 30:4 and Deuteronomy 27:9.
c3-deu-0011: The commandment is given that day. A blessing is named for two everyday vessels. Read Deuteronomy 28:5 and Deuteronomy 30:11.
c3-deu-0012: Moses called all Israel and reminded them of all that was done. Read Deuteronomy 30:5 and Deuteronomy 29:2.
c2-lev-0010: A rule is given about the altar fire. Read Leviticus 6:13.
c2-lev-0011: Moses placed something in the breastplate. The priest then tends the altar. Read Leviticus 8:8 and Leviticus 7:31.
c3-lev-0008: A lasting food rule is given. Moses also put something on the turban. Read Leviticus 3:17 and Leviticus 8:9.
c3-lev-0009: The priest is to carry the ashes outside the camp. Nadab and Abihu were also carried out. Read Leviticus 6:11 and Leviticus 10:5.
c3-lev-0010: Nadab and Abihu came before the LORD. The book opens with the LORD speaking to Moses. Read Leviticus 10:1 and Leviticus 1:1.
c3-lev-0011: The priest continues that rite. Moses then made careful inquiry. Read Leviticus 10:16 and Leviticus 4:7.
c3-lev-0012: The offering shall remain on the hearth all night until morning. Moses tells Aaron what the LORD had spoken. Read Leviticus 10:3 and Leviticus 6:9.
c3-lev-0013: Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle. Read Leviticus 9:23 and Leviticus 7:1.
c3-lev-0014: Another stated law is given. Moses dressed Aaron, beginning with the tunic and the sash. Read Leviticus 8:7 and Leviticus 6:14.
c3-lev-0015: An act is done before the LORD with the bull. A later verse deals with a spoken oath. Read Leviticus 5:4 and Leviticus 4:15.
c2-num-0012: Moses called on the LORD whenever the ark set out. Read Numbers 10:35.
c2-num-0013: The verse speaks of what God will not do. Later the LORD grants a pardon. Read Numbers 23:19 and Numbers 14:20.
c3-num-0006: God spoke a command to Balaam. A place is appointed for the Levites. Read Numbers 22:12 and Numbers 3:9.
c3-num-0007: The LORD tells what He has done with the Levites. Moses questions the children of Gad and Reuben. Read Numbers 3:12 and Numbers 32:6.
c3-num-0008: God gave the sons of Kohath care for holy things. Read Numbers 4:15 and Numbers 24:11.
c3-num-0009: Balaam asks, “How shall I curse whom God has not cursed?” Read Numbers 10:14 and Numbers 23:8.
c3-num-0010: Balaam departed, and Balak also went his way. Read Numbers 32:16 and Numbers 24:25.
c3-num-0011: Moses prays that the power of the Lord be great. Read Numbers 35:6 and Numbers 14:17.
c3-num-0012: Reuben and Gad saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead. Read Numbers 23:21 and Numbers 32:1.
c3-num-0013: Hobab the son of Reuel is named. Messengers are sent to Balaam the son of Beor. Read Numbers 22:5 and Numbers 10:29.
c2-job-0018: The LORD describes a great creature. Read Job 40:17.
c2-job-0019: Three names are given in order. The LORD also describes the creature’s strength. Read Job 42:14 and Job 40:16.
c3-job-0021: Job’s daughters are described, and their father acts toward them. Shade is pictured around the creature. Read Job 42:15 and Job 40:22.
c3-job-0022: The LORD asks about wisdom. Job’s wife also speaks to him. Read Job 38:36 and Job 2:9.
c3-job-0023: The LORD asks a question about the eagle. Job’s later years are then counted. Read Job 39:27 and Job 42:16.
c3-job-0024: The LORD asks about the lightnings. The verse then tells what Job did. Read Job 2:8 and Job 38:35.
c3-job-0025: Job’s sons would feast in their houses, each on his appointed day. The LORD speaks to the sea. Read Job 38:11 and Job 1:4.
c3-job-0026: Job lived one hundred and forty years after this. A later verse describes the creature’s body. Read Job 41:23 and Job 42:16.
c3-job-0027: Job’s goods are placed in another’s power, yet a limit is set. The great creature is described again. Read Job 41:21 and Job 1:12.
c3-job-0028: The LORD blessed Job’s latter days more than his beginning. Read Job 2:10 and Job 42:12.
c2-psa-0025: The LORD tells what He has set. Read Psalm 2:6.
c2-psa-0026: A spoken line opens the verse. He shall also speak in His wrath. Read Psalm 2:7 and Psalm 2:5.
c3-psa-0019: The psalm ends with a blessing. His wrath is heard in the earlier verse. Read Psalm 2:12 and Psalm 2:5.
c3-psa-0020: The verse tells how the nations will be dealt with. The psalm opens with a question. Read Psalm 2:9 and Psalm 2:1.
c3-psa-0021: The kings and rulers speak. The Lord is at Your right hand. Read Psalm 2:3 and Psalm 110:5.
c3-psa-0022: The nations rage, and the people plot a vain thing. The later verse tells what He shall do. Read Psalm 110:7 and Psalm 2:1.
c3-psa-0023: They will come to a people who will be born. The other verse ends with a call. Read Psalm 118:24 and Psalm 22:31.
c3-psa-0024: The Lord is at Your right hand. The psalm then tells what the LORD will do. Read Psalm 2:4 and Psalm 110:5.
c3-psa-0025: The psalm speaks of His judging. A later call opens before the next address. Read Psalm 2:10 and Psalm 110:6.
c3-psa-0026: The ends of the world shall turn to the LORD. The other verse tells what follows His oath. Read Psalm 110:4 and Psalm 22:27.
c2-psa-0027: The psalm offers a short prayer. Read Psalm 90:12.
c2-psa-0028: The psalm tells what He has broken. God is everlasting. Read Psalm 107:16 and Psalm 90:2.
c3-psa-0027: God promises to guide him. A later verse speaks of a chosen servant. Read Psalm 73:24 and Psalm 89:20.
c3-psa-0028: He cares for the longing soul. The other psalm tells what a trusted friend did. Read Psalm 41:9 and Psalm 107:9.
c3-psa-0029: A psalm asks to see the good of God’s chosen ones. Read Psalm 72:4 and Psalm 106:5.
c3-psa-0030: “Lord, You have been our dwelling place in all generations.” The other verse continues after its opening call. Read Psalm 107:2 and Psalm 90:1.
c3-psa-0031: He is honored for His mighty acts. The other psalm asks a second question after the first. Read Psalm 106:2 and Psalm 150:2.
c3-psa-0032: The psalm calls us to give thanks for His goodness. A later line speaks of His faithfulness. Read Psalm 89:5 and Psalm 107:8.
c3-psa-0033: The psalm looks ahead to a lasting peace. A short prayer is offered to the LORD. Read Psalm 106:4 and Psalm 72:7.
c3-psa-0034: The psalm names loud cymbals and clashing cymbals. The other verse tells what belongs to Him. Read Psalm 89:11 and Psalm 150:5.
